articles.title: OpenAI Rolls Out GPT-5.6—But Only for Some Users Due to Trump Admin
articles.snippet: OpenAI introduced the GPT-5.6 family of AI models on Friday, but only limited users can access them for now thanks to the U.S. government.

articles.title: Trump Administration Asks OpenAI to Limit GPT-5.6 Rollout: Reports
articles.snippet: The reported request to OpenAI follows the Trump administration's move to limit access to Anthropic's Fable 5 and Mythos 5 AI models.
